cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(private_memory_fork C ASM)
find_package(DynamoRIO REQUIRED)
add_library(private_memory_fork_client SHARED client.c)
configure_DynamoRIO_client(private_memory_fork_client)
target_compile_options(private_memory_fork_client PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
add_executable(private_memory_fork_guest guest.S)
target_link_options(private_memory_fork_guest PRIVATE -nostdlib -static -no-pie -Wl,--build-id=none)
add_executable(private_memory_fork_supervisor supervisor.c)
target_compile_options(private_memory_fork_supervisor PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
